name: Fearless
body:
You have overcome the effects of magical fear.

Prerequisite: Oakling, Wis 15.

Benefit: If a spell or spell-like effect causes you to be panicked or frightened, you are instead shaken. You cannot be shaken otherwise by a spell or spell-like effect.
